authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner’s section 2 *navalla gives Prakrit ṇavalla/ṇavullaḍaya and specifically Gujarati navlũ “new”. The neighbouring Bhil forms preserve the same n-v-l stem or its regular vowel-contracted counterpart and gender endings. This follows the Gujarati comparator in section 2; Kumaoni/Nepali naulo, for which Turner also allows *navala, is deliberately not included.
